QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_66

question.text: Under SAS-1300 the BHIM / UPI / PayTM digital-payment adoption indicator should be verified using:

answer.text: NPCI aggregated district-wise UPI volume + partner-bank transaction logs + beneficiary demo-day proof + sub-sample 6-month-later check

explanation.text: The Logic: NPCI publishes aggregated district-wise UPI data; partner banks provide individual transaction flags; demo-day is evidence of skill acquisition; 6-month retention is sustainability. All four together are SAS-1300 evidence-complete. The Trap: Options B, C, D are uncorroborated single-source. Cross-Exam Context: NPCI / digital-payment triangulation in XXIV AML and V-A (MF Distributor). Assessor's Pro-Tip: NPCI's district UPI growth data is public. Control for district-wide UPI growth before attributing usage to the SE — else you over-claim by the secular trend.
